title: Amazon customers may be treated worse
text:
I got Pusheen's fall 2020 box and really loved it. The contents were worth the money and the overall experience was wonderful. However, for their winter box they shipped the boxes out to the people who subscribe directly through their site TWO MONTHS early, meaning every single item in the 'mystery' box was not only spoiled by countless people online, but even the Pusheen Box's own facebook page posted the entire contents of the box more than two weeks before they even ship to Amazon customers.
This was due partly to shipping issues they experienced for the fall box, but spoiling the box on your official instagram and facebook page? Completely unprofessional.
label: neutral
